pages.text: This mod requires:$(li)$(item)Serene Seasons$() for the season system itself$(li)$(item)BetterDays$() for the time-speed mechanics used by seasonal day & night$(br2)$(item)Jade$() is optional: if installed, crop progress and fertilizing state show up in Jade tooltips.$(br2)$(item)Touhou Little Maid$() is optional too: with it installed, a maid in farm mode waters your plots, fertilizes within the daily allowance and stops sowing out of season - see the Maid Farm Work chapter.
